newsitem.title: GERMANY: Volksfuersorge says 4-mth new business rose.
newsitem.headline: Volksfuersorge says 4-mth new business rose.

text.p: German insurance group Volksfuersorge Holding AG said on Wednesday its new business had received a significant boost in the first four months of 1997.
In a statement issued ahead of its annual news conference, the company, part of the AMB Holding group, said life and non-life business had "clearly picked up" this year.
In non-life insurance, around 160,000 new contracts were signed, an increase of 27 percent, with car insurance alone registering an advance of 60 percent in new business.
Non-life claims had continued to fall, apart from around 3,000 claims relating to storm damage at the beginning of the year.
